notes.title: Deflector's Summer major update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/34b710f5afd8f5f22d8bd9e513de64df0e0bec82.png[/img]

Greetings, Specimens! You may have witnessed the full release of Deflector, but we did tell you updates were still going to happen! And it's time for a big one.

This scorching Summer update brings with it multiple ways to become stronger both for you, and for your dire foes. We'll cover them in great detail further down the line, but for now let's dive right in with the broad strokes.

[previewyoutube=RUrGrfSKUng;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]New evolutions for each bio-shell[/h3]
Whether you just can't stop bouncing boomerangs as the Eradicator or bully viruses with Lightfist's punches - every bio-shell in the game is getting a brand new evolution! Unlocking them however isn't as simple as looking the Deflector AI straight in the eye(s) and saying "Pretty please". You'll have to complete a challenge to unlock each of them. 

[h3]New virus strains[/h3]
Since you've been doing so well against the existing virus strains it's time to add some new ones to the mix. With a total of four, you'll find them doing interesting things to the bullets you're used to deflecting and the enemies you're used to seeing in a given biome. 

[h3]New anomalies[/h3]
Rockets and larvae and poison puddles - oh my!

[h3]New languages added to the game[/h3]
Deflector is now available in Traditional Chinese and Japanese!

[h3]Balance tweaks to Lightfist's Multiple Strike Evolution[/h3]
Now breaking 6 marks instead of 3 and having twice the range!

We are far from done with Deflector and you can expect more updates further down the line. In the meantime - have fun in the petri dish!

notes.title: The full release update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=oRjK8_DmImE;full][/previewyoutube]
The wait is over and the Deflector experiment is now fully operational. To those of you who have been with us through Early Access - thank you. And to those of you who are first discovering the game - welcome. Both of you can read on to see all the juiciest and most enticing additions to Deflector. 

[h2]Six Bioshells[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4ff8688e9ccfeb0be5c0fc29fa962929b3558795.gif[/img]

In the full version of Deflector, unlock up to six different bioshells, each with a unique set of weapons, abilities and ways to Deflect projectiles. The Corrupted, the newest bioshell to join Deflector, is an unusual one to say the least, and it’s only by overcoming the new two-stage incarnation of the final boss that you can get him!

[h2]Survival Chamber[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/51807df9c291f60d468c5fdd4ef2958d0fde4862.gif[/img]

A new mode of play perfect for those with a competitive streak! Defend the Hub from approaching bombs while being relentlessly assaulted by viruses both big and small. This mode of play is unlocked by playing Deflector.

Survival Chamber also comes with a global leaderboard, showing your results against every eager participant of the experiment out there! We plan to make use of that leaderboard very soon, so keep an eye out for an announcement.

[h2]Virus Strains[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/849a2a4806a70d7eaa2f965e0b34f0e5cbdcfcca.gif[/img]

In this new end game mode, you get to build your own difficulty! Choose to inject each biome with up to five Virus Strains, each resulting in an additional random debuff. This mode is not only a way to keep you on your toes even when you’ve mastered all that the path to the final boss can offer! It’s also tied to the new Proficiency system. 

With Proficiency, each bioshell now has a list of five permanent buffs, unlockable through Virus Strains. Feeling particularly confident about your Eradicator boomerang game? Want to show you can really shine as Spark? Challenge the Virus Strains with your favorite bioshells and grow stronger with each level of Virus Strain you have beaten.

[h2]Moving forward[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/317dcd83a49ff3b780bace195c6c9f0804c9cf8c.gif[/img]

Although Deflector is now available in its fully released version, that doesn’t mean work on it is finished for good. We will continue to work hard to balance, update, and keep Deflector a great game to play. You can look below for a full list of changes and tweaks. In the meantime - have a wonderful time in the petri dish, Specimens!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*] New bioshell, Corrupted, added to the game with 5 unique bioshell mutations
[*] New final world map added
[*] Final boss now has a second stage
[*] New end game mechanic: “Virus strains”
[*] Proficiency level added to every bioshell
[*] New outfit added for every bioshell
[*] New game mode: “Survival Chamber” with leaderboards
[*] New enemy type: Champions
[*] Character selection screen and UI updated
[*] KarlOS now displays Evolutions at the Collector’s Laboratory
[*] Dialogue UI updated and new dialogues have been added
[*] New sound for UI and dialogues
[*] New room types added (Blood extraction and Nest)
[*] DNA upgrades fully reworked
[*] Added save slots to the game
[*] New music track added to Hollow Hive Apex Virus fight
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Active ability no longer charges from deflecting, but from damaging enemies with your main weapon or deflected projectiles.
[*] Bioshell unlock challenges updated for Spark and Lightfist
[*] DNA is now received at the end of every room rather than drop from enemies
[*] Damage numbers now change color based on type of damage. Enemy health bars are also adjusted based on max health and type of enemy
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]

[list]
[*] Hub healing station base health reduced (30⏩25)
[/list]
[b]Bioshells[/b]
[i]Slasher[/i]
[list]
[*] Radial Slash (Deflection) only consumes Rage if it hits an enemy
[/list]
[i]Gunslinger[/i]
[list]
[*] Deflect damage increased (30⏩50)
[/list]
[i]Lightfist[/i]
[list]
[*] Invisible obstacles (like room edges) now count as obstacles for the purpose of inflicting collision damage to enemies you push
[*] Breaking mark damage increased (40⏩50)
[*] Base damage increased  (65⏩80)
[*] Active skill hit damage increased (160⏩180)
[/list]
[i]Spark[/i]
[list]
[*] Active ability DPS increased (400⏩450)
[/list]

[b]Nucleoli[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Jetpack:[/i] Now adds 10% increase to your Attack and Deflect damage as long as it's active.
[*] [i]Protective Pond:[/i] Now heals you every second while you remain inside it.
[*] [i]Lightning Storm:[/i] No longer strikes randomly, but instead targets a certain amount of nearby enemies. The higher the tier, the more bolts will strike.
[/list]

[b]Neutral Mutations[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Guided projectiles:[/i] Number of projectiles increased (6⏩10) and projectile increment per tier increased (1⏩4)
[*] [i]Projectile storm:[/i] Base damage increased (80⏩120) and cooldown reduced (3⏩2)
[*] [i]Electrical storm:[/i] Base damage increased (90⏩170), gap time between required kills increased. (3s⏩4s)
[*] [i]Impale:[/i] Base damage increased (30⏩50)
[*] [i]Death mark:[/i] Base damage increased (80⏩100), marked enemies cap increased (4⏩8)
[*] [i]Blossom:[/i] Cooldown reduced (5s⏩3s), and damage increment per tier increased (15⏩30)
[*] [i]Hunter’s call:[/i] Damage increment per tier increased (4>6)
[*] [i]Deflect burst:[/i] Base damage increased (120⏩150), and now marks appear over time, but there can only be on at a time.
[*] [i]Deflecting turret:[/i] Base deflects required for activation reduced (8>6) deflects required decrement per tier reduced (2⏩1)
[*] [i]Repulsive wave:[/i] Base damage increased (100⏩120), range increased (5⏩8) and rage increment per tier increased (1⏩4)
[*] [i]Bubbles:[/i] Base chance of deflecting a bullet increased (10%⏩12%) ,and chance per tier increased (10%⏩15%)
[*] [i]Charged disc:[/i] Charge time reduced (4s⏩3s) and base damage increased (120⏩150)
[*] [i]Explosive metabolism:[/i] Base damage reduced (300⏩250) and range reduced (8⏩7)
[*] [i]Survival armor:[/i] Now activates when close to an Apex or Great virus as well.
[*] [i]Protective deflect:[/i] No longer resets when dashing.
[*] [i]Speedrunner:[/i] Speed increment increased (20%⏩30%), duration increment per tier increased (1s⏩2s)
[*] [i]Clean zone:[/i] Base duration increased (3s⏩4s), and size increment per deflect increased (10⏩12)
[*] [i]Portable medkit:[/i] No longer disables after visiting a Safe Point.
[/list]

[b]Evolutions[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Linked boomerang[/i] (Eradicator): Base damage increased (70⏩90)
[*] [i]Explosive boomerang[/i] (Eradicator): Deflections required reduced (3⏩2)
[*] [i]Powerful spin[/i] (Slasher): Base damage increased (100⏩200)
[*] [i]Explosive bolts[/i] (Gunslinger): Bullets now explode as long as you have no dash charges left.
[*] [i]Area shot[/i] (Gunslinger): Base damage increased (30⏩40)
[*] [i]Multiple strike[/i] (Lightfist): Has been reworked. New effect: “Marking an enemy marks other nearby enemies, and each time you break a mark, it also breaks the mark of up to X other enemies.”
[*] [i]Skillful orbs[/i] (Spark): Has been reworked. New effect: ”Increase speed of Extended Orbit and reduce damage taken while using it.”
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue causing Spinning Dash to release more boomerangs than intended.
[*] Resolved an issue causing a visual error with the Triple Sword evolution.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.1 - New Tricks
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, everyone! [/h3]
Our previous update has brought along some major changes (some of which we also examined in greater detail in subsequent articles). And what does [b]Deflector[/b] do in response to change? It adapts! So today we would like to announce our next update and the bag of new trick it comes with. 

What’s more, the [b]Winter Sale[/b] is on, so read until the end to find out about the bargain we have in store for you on the freshly updated Deflector!

Let’s kick off with changes to the Specimens. Some have more and some have fewer but they’ll all have an effect:

[h3]Slasher[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slasher’s attacks now have increased range;
[*] Slasher now generates Rage when dealing damage to enemies with his basic attack;
[*] When Rage is available, Slasher’s Deflect ability consumes it, becoming wider and dealing more damage based on the amount of Rage consumed; 
[*] Slasher throws a sword by holding down and releasing Deflect. This consumes Rage. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7246f3d6da2129cbeb42ef9bc31630a584e2b353.gif[/img]
[h3]Gunslinger[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gunslinger no longer has infinite range and his shots gain some spread;
[*] Gunslinger’s Deflect ability now creates a deflecting screen that you can hold, drastically lowering your movement speed while you defend yourself;
[*] Gunslinger’s active ability can now spawn up to 3 turrets by pressing the active ability button again within the first 5 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Spark[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spark’s active ability now fires a beam of light that deals damage and pierces through enemies.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d26c9b6020969d0f1f860ecd720c9a45627623f7.gif[/img]
[h3]Lightfist[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lightfist now marks enemies by hitting them with deflected projectiles; 
[*] Hitting marked enemies with Lightfist’s punches breaks the marks and inflicts additional damage; 
[*] Lightfist’s Deflect now pushes enemies. If this causes the enemy to collide with an object, it takes significant damage.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a4bb5b69a4493e6a3da1b899b52848a345955ed7.gif[/img]

Your foes aren’t without some changes either! The following Great and Apex Viruses have been updated: 

[h3]Great Viruses[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The Serpent’s[/b] wave attack has been reworked; 
[*] [b]Obelisk’s[/b] attacks have been improved. The fight should be more dynamic now!
[/list]
[h3]Apex Virus[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] has made some renovations to its arena, changing its shape;
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] had an overhaul to its attacks, with some being removed; 
[*] [b]Horned Giant[/b] now summons two walls in the second phase of the fight. They will shoot lines of projectiles periodically 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/06078cc9887ee8c90dff05b1299c78b9f55ecf2d.gif[/img]

While those are some of the changes easy to put a Specimen or Virus’ nametag to, there’s also a slew of other improvements to the game! Here’s a list of more general changes you’ll find in the game following this update: 
[list]
[*] Some specimen evolutions have been updated to match the changes to the Specimens;
[*] Great and Apex viruses can now be affected by Altered states;
[*] Freeze now reduces the affected enemy’s movement speed and projectile velocity instead of stunning. Bonus effects have been upgraded accordingly; 
[*] 4 new mutations added to the roster. They’ll be unlocked by default;
[*] 4 additional new mutations added to the roster. They’ll be unlocked by increasing your Research Level;
[*] Inner Roots (Nucleolus) now roots the enemy and deals damage; 
[*] Little Crawler (Nucleolus) added. It summons spider minions to aid you in combat!
[/list]

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Resolved issue that caused chasing laser anomaly to appear too close;
[*] Resolved game occasionally softlocking when pausing just before Oogles picked you up at the end of the room;
[*] Resolved anomalous Toxic Tentacle behavior causing them to sometimes not appear/reappear properly. 
[/list]

That’s it for the update! 

What’s more, you can pick up Deflector with all its most up-to-date features at a [b]25% discount[/b]! Deflector is part of the Winter Sale and is available at this special festive price from Dec 22, 2022 - Jan 5, 2023 10am Pacific. Don’t miss it!

[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Patch note 0.7.4.4
Lightfist Update is live!
⚙️ Gunslinger & Spark upcoming changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Not so long ago we mentioned Deflector’s 4th upcoming update. It’s about time we started pinning down some details for you! Today we’ll be putting Gunslinger and Spark under the microscope to show you the overhaul that they’ve gone through.

[b]Gunslinger[/b]
Gunslinger is still armed to the teeth, but the way his ammo works has gone through some changes. Where before the energy gauge (seen as a white arch under your feet) would be spent from firing your primary weapon, it is now responsible for your powerful deflective shotgun blast.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/0966b8da4699892ea6e954aa83068d1ab9a5610d.gif[/img] 

The two shotgun shell icons above the Gunslinger’s head show you how many you have left. Killing enemies refills your gauge which (by default) maxes out at two shots with which to deflect enemy projectiles and generally ruin their day. The gauge also gradually refills over time, so patience has its own rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7539d525f3249a75d09c5d4a8eaf64bd7ed81466.gif[/img]
 
You’ll also notice Gunslinger only has two dash charges you can use back to back. But if you time your shots, dodges and shotgun blasts, you can wreak a lot of havoc. Your ultimate ability still spawns your turret buddy to multiply firepower.
 

[b]Spark[/b]
Spark has gone through some major changes. Where before your basic left click attack only recalled the orbs launched with your deflect ability, you can now hold it down to make them orbit  you at a certain distance. The orbs damage enemies as they pass through them, so by positioning yourself right you can get consistent damage. Even through obstacles!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/fb38a2f7ccf8a312e57d1cbb17c4781f22821152.gif[/img]
 
You deflect bullets by launching your orbs at them. Time your deflection as one of your orbs passes in front of you to send it flying through projectiles and enemies alike. Your left click will recall any orbs you have launched, dealing damage to enemies they pass on their way back! Other than deflecting projectiles, this can also serve as a source of heavy damage against enemies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/5e4a7a17ac4c9f9ee5449cbeded7b428be86bbea.gif[/img] 

So now that your spinning orbs are your basic means of attack, what does Spark’s ultimate do? Well, in an appropriately sparking display you’ll transform into a bolt of lightning for a few seconds. This lets you move around at a high speed, dealing damage to everything in your path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d781356c2a234c29557a7d6a9859639d343c0687.gif[/img]

We can’t wait for you to get your hands on the updated Gunslinger and Spark, but there are other major changes and additions in store as well. Find out more about them in the coming weeks!

notes.title: 🛠 Hivestorm update is out today!
notes.notes:
The wait is over! [b]The Hivestorm update[/b] is out today! We think it’s a good time to recap all that there is to see in the new world and beyond it. 

[previewyoutube=PLPiNrgR0t4;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Travel into the Hollow Hive[/b]

The Hollow Hive is the fourth world in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736550/Deflector/]Deflector[/url]. A world of soil and the skittering sound of insect legs. The virus here clearly took inspiration from some creepy crawlies, and they’re coming for you as you intrude on their violent domain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/4301a65be7c39d7a4c859100bbe4daad67e84fff.png[/img]

At the top of the food-chain here are the [b]Giant Centipedes[/b]. This deadly trio will keep you on your toes not just with projectiles, but with rapid burrowing and reemerging from the ground. Stay on the move. There’s little room to wait patiently for the shots to reach you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/ddbeff677db88623243a79c2790efe203cc21f56.png[/img]

If you can overcome the Giant Centipedes, you’ll be rewarded with one of two powerful mutations tied to your active ability. 

[list]
[*] [b]Rock Skin[/b] surrounds you with a shell of stone, making you invincible for a short period of time.
[*] [b]Inner Roots[/b] releases a wide cobweb that roots all enemies affected.
[/list] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e741190ad3cbfc2396214e632c7db3a88d5664f1.png[/img]

We know you probably can’t wait to challenge the Hollow Hive, but let’s not forget the other three worlds. Living Entrails, Toxic Sea and Magnetic Fields all got new locations to explore. So revisit them, especially if you’ve yet to best the Apex Viruses at the end of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/500c372fa625d56b90a92f96fbe2b9d960c4faa1.png[/img]

Remember, after each defeated Apex Virus your subsequent runs will get harder. You only need to beat three Apexes to face the Core, so choose your path wisely!

Along with new content, this update also brings some improvements: 
[list]
[*] Updated Hunter UI
[*] Updated Mutation Shop UI
[*] Better homing on deflected projectiles
[*] Increased base healing amount when resting at a Safe Point
[*] Reduced Gunslinger turret duration
[*] Fixed bug causing interaction messages not properly disappearing after exiting to the menu
[/list]
We’re excited to bring you this update and are looking forward to your feedback. Have fun and [url=https://discord.gg/n7ua6jkvNv]stay in touch[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/d517573fcc475186e261ab718d2060886f8aca12.png[/img]

notes.title: Deflector's Massive Update!
notes.notes:
The release of Specimen One introduced a new system that we’re finally ready to present to everyone! 
There are several key changes that we want to highlight.

[h1][b]Hub Progression[/b][/h1] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/a63af255a250d4e188a24d1fa65cc313fb79179a.png[/img]

We’ve remade the hub progression, only leaving fun and meaningful upgrades that would make your runs more interesting. Because of such a massive change we’re going to refund all the points for the previous upgrades with some adjustments due to the size of the upgrade table.

[h1][b]Run Progression[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7eaf56cc2bb6b6073e13d8ab00dab2e2e4661d7e.jpg[/img]

The progression on the game map was streamlined due to the changes in the reward drops. We wanted to make sure that players always have a choice and would try more challenging maps for a better chance of reward.

[h1][b]Mutation Table[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/7cca850f39a72505a45e98ca9fbc36930029767f.png[/img]

When changing mutation table we wanted to make sure that our puzzle-like DNA progression will make the run progression fun and meaningful. 

You will be using three things during your run progression:

[b]Mutations[/b]
Mutations are your awesome skills that change your gameplay depending on what you pick. Decoys, explosions, giant boomerangs and more.

[b]Strands[/b]
These blank hexagonal connections will help you reach different traits and give you more freedom of choosing where to go.

[b]Traits[/b]
Previously known as alterations, these were remade as [b]Traits[/b] that grant different effects. They exist to help you fine-tune your build during the run. To activate the traits you need to place [b]Mutation[/b] or [b]Strand[/b] near it and then it will open more alterations around it! Duplicate Traits improve the overall effects.


Roguelite progression inside roguelite!

[h1][b]Reward Drops[/b][/h1]

The entire drop system was overhauled to better fit the systems higher. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323884/e09863b6109a1e560e6f1da7e85c61a2a988d585.png[/img]

[b]Cells[/b]
This is the currency you can use in shops.

[b]DNA[/b]
This is used to upgrade everything in the Hub.

[b]Virus Samples[/b]
This is used to open new droppable Mutations.

Additionally rooms can drop blanks (with certain upgrades affecting the rate) and in rare cases mutations.

[b]The most important - you can now quit the game during the run and return from where you’ve ended.[/b]

So that’s it! Have fun in Deflector and don’t forget to leave your feedback about the new systems!


[h2][b]Here is the full patchnote:[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]New features[/b][/h3]

[b]New DNA unlocks[/b]
[list]
[*] Almost all DNA unlocks have been re-done in order to be more useful during the game. Cost has been balanced so it does not take really long to unlock them.

[b]New Traits (previously alterations)[/b]
[*] Traits have been re-done in order to grant effects that allows you to fine-tune your build.
[*] The more duplicate Traits you activate the more powerful they become.

[b]Strands added as a rewards[/b]
[*] Strands act as a blank mutation, as they can be placed in the DNA table in order to reach other traits, but do not have any other effect.

[b]New DNA table system[/b]
[*] New DNA table, together with the new reward system, allows for more customization based on the traits selected. Which lets you create different build styles based on how you place everything inside it.
[*] Table now always starts with four random initial traits. And when a trait is activated, two new traits appear close to that one (three with the upgrade).

[b]New map progression[/b]
[*] Map scheme has been remade in order to make the player’s choice more meaningful. 
[*] Paths now will have several nodes in a row, so choosing your path will play a bigger role now.

[h3][b]New drop and reward system[/b][/h3]
[*] Reward system has been completely re-done in order to avoid choosing between “short-term fun” and “long-term efficiency” and increasing “reward vs risk” decisions.
[*] Only mutations are now shown on the map.
[*] Cells drop in all rooms. Quantity increased in harder arenas.
[*] DNA now has a chance to be dropped when killing enemies. Chance increased in harder arenas.
[*] Virus samples always drop in elite rooms and after defeating a world boss.
[*] Mutations now drop in a random arena in one of the paths. Usually they appear on the more challenging routes. 
[*] Strands drop randomly in any combat room where a mutation is not dropped. Chance increases with the challenges attached to the arenas.
[*] Health orbs no longer drops but you can get more health through traits. We may add certain other ways to drop health later.
[*] A shop now can always be found in quest rooms.
[*] Dispenser added to shops. Dispenser allows you to buy unlimited amount of strands.

[b]Added new nodes on the map:[/b]
[*] [b]Safe point:[/b] you can restore health and sometimes meet interesting NPCs, so keep a close eye on this room in future updates.
[*] [b]Survival:[/b] You will need to survive waves of enemies until the timer runs out.

[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]
[*] Slasher costume for Specimen One added.
[*] New slasher skin is available for any player who reached 100 viruses killed in the Last Stand room in Specimen One demo.
[*] Mutation tooltips. Every time you get a duplicate mutation you’ll get a special message saying it.
[*] Preview Mutations in shop. Mutation orbs that you buy in shop will have the picture of the mutation inside the orb.
[*] Shops before the boss added. Completing the quest “The Prisoner” unlocks the pre-boss shop.
[*] Tutorial has been remade with new enemies and map.
[*] Steam achievements added 
[*] Challenge arenas has been removed. Anomalies can appear now randomly in every combat arena.
[*] Improved character collision deteaction.
[*] Saps quest is redone and now serves as an introduction to the quest system.
[*] Anomaly challenge “Wounded” is temporarily removed from the game.
[*] Arena challenges is now scaling better with the progression.
[*] Shops can now be interacted from all sides

notes.title: Hotfix - Deflector Ver. 0.69
notes.notes:
[b]Hello assistants, it's time to fine-tune the experiments![/b]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Gunslinger's turret now deflects properly.
[*] Magnetic Fields boss' room collisions are more consistent now.
[*] Mole enemy has been temporarily removed from the game.
[*] Eradicator's boomerang catch distance was slightly reduced to improve boomerang deflect accuracy.
[*] Hub options are now navigatable with a Dpad.
[*] New font added for the Russian language.
[*] Fixed collisions in Living Entrails and Magnetic Fields arenas.
[*] Settings values are now applied from the moment the game is opened.
[*] Blob enemy now jumps at you when attacking.
[*] DefleKT enemies no longer shield nearby allies, instead they create a static shield dome.
[*] Volt enemies now shoot three bullets.
[*] Added confirmation window when exiting or giving up the run.
[*] Overall improves to the attacks of the final bosses of all the worlds.
[*] Health bard for all enemies now displays in white the amount of damage dealt.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Solved an issue where dashing was sometimes not consuming a dash charge.
[*] Slasher’s second challenge now unlocks the correct variation.
[*] Solved an issue when mutation “Energy Wave” was not dealing damage.
[*] Solved an issue where enemy tracking arrows were getting stuck.
[*] Mind field bombs no longer spawn above the character.
[*] Solved an issue where sometimes you could get perma poisoned while over the boat in Treasure Island mission. 
[*] Vsync now works properly.

Expect some interesting changes to the progression, mutations and more!

notes.title: Community Update #1 - "The world of Deflector and Specimen One"
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello, our precious assistants.[/h2]

February is upon us which means we're working hard on the upcoming update to the Deflector, Specimen Zero and the release of Specimen One.

Specimen One will focus on Slasher and begins slowly building the lore for the world of Deflector which of course will reflect in the main game and Specimen Zero. All players who will play through Specimen One will be able to get a unique skin for him as you did with Eradicator.

Hello everyone! We're hoping you're enjoying your time in Deflector and we're glad that you are sending us your feedback, ideas and bug reports.

[*] Eradicator's Alpha amount of deflects to reach maximum range are reduced by one.

[*] Bridges in Magnetic Fields world now glow to be more visible
[/list]

[b]Localization: [/b]

[/list]

Don't forget to report any findings in our [url=https://discord.gg/FpqJacCbey]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1736550/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]. 

We've also updated the FAQ with several questions:

[b]Is there a story in the game?[/b]
Yes, it's hidden in the world and interactions and will be developing through other means besides the game as well.

[b]Are there any tips for the quests and opening characters?[/b]
The game itself is made to be challenging whereas variations of the characters can be opened by looking at the Specimens and their respective challenges in the main menu. However, to open characters, to fully complete quest lines and open more content players need to learn more about the world and explore it.

[b]How many characters are currently in the game?[/b]
Four characters with three variations each, which makes it around twelve different playstyles available to players in the game.
